brief: Compact gambrel-roofed barn about 30 ft by 50 ft, sided in barn-red vertical ribbed siding with a few small white-framed four-pane windows, a sliding track door on the long side and a hinged plank door. The rusty-streaked galvanized metal roof projects far out at the gable peak as a pointed hay hood over a boarded loft door. Stands on open prairie with a lone bare tree; plain and well-maintained.
